TEXT.citation: Sung, L. M., Lily, I., Hsieh, F., & Lin, Z. (2008). Developing an online corpus of Formosan languages. Taiwan Journal of Linguistics, 6(2.).
TEXT.BibTeX_citation: @article{sung2008developing,title={Developing an online corpus of Formosan languages.},author={Sung, Li-May and Lily, I and Hsieh, Fuhui and Lin, Zhemin and others},journal={Taiwan Journal of Linguistics},volume={6},number={2},year={2008}}

S.FORM: tangi pakunkupaiku tu zana masang baqita nizi tayilanan.
S.PHON: taŋi pakunkupaiku tu [z|r]ana masaŋ βaqita ni[z|r]i tajiranan
S.FORM: tangi pakunkupaiku tu zana masang baqita nizi tayilanan.
S.PHON: taŋi pakunkupaiku tu [z|r]ana masaŋ βaqita ni[z|r]i tajiranan
S.TRANSL: 今天我要講一個故事, 是有關我們祖先起源於宜蘭的故事.
Today, I am going to tell a story about our ancestors coming from Yi-lan.

S.FORM: masang tayan tayilanan nani mwaza zengnana mwaza banangna baqian tayan na baybedan bayita.
S.PHON: masaŋ tajan tajiranan nani mwa[z|r]a [z|r]əŋnana mwa[z|r]a βanaŋna βaqian tajan na βajβəɮan βajita
S.FORM: masang tayan tayilanan nani mwaza zengnana mwaza banangna baqian tayan na baybedan bayita.
S.PHON: masaŋ tajan tajiranan nani mwa[z|r]a [z|r]əŋnana mwa[z|r]a βanaŋna βaqian tajan na βajβəɮan βajita
S.TRANSL: 從前在宜蘭有很多我們祖先的水田和土地.
Some time ago in Yi-lan there were many farms and lands of our ancestors'.

S.FORM: yauti busus maseq taiyan matiw ta yilanan nani.
S.PHON: jauti βusus masəq taijan matiw ta jiranan nani
S.FORM: yauti busus maseq taiyan matiw ta yilanan nani.
S.PHON: jauti βusus masəq taijan matiw ta jiranan nani
S.TRANSL: 然後就有漢人到了宜蘭去.
Then, Han people arrived there…went to Yi-lan.

S.FORM: supaR qaniawu kasianem tu sanaqunian tu mala tu zengnana baqita bayita.
S.PHON: supaʁ qaniawu kasianəm tu sanaqunian tu mara tu [z|r]əŋnana βaqita βajita
S.FORM: supaR qaniawu kasianem tu sanaqunian tu mala tu zengnana baqita bayita.
S.PHON: supaʁ qaniawu kasianəm tu sanaqunian tu mara tu [z|r]əŋnana βaqita βajita
S.TRANSL: 他們很懂得計畫該如何才能得到祖先們的水田.
They were good at planning how to obtain our ancestors' farms.

S.FORM: wanay kebalan muaza lisinna tu zana metiwuay.
S.PHON: wanaj kəβaran mua[z|r]a risinna tu [z|r]ana mətiwuaj
S.FORM: wanay kebalan muaza lisinna tu zana metiwuay.
S.PHON: wanaj kəβaran mua[z|r]a risinna tu [z|r]ana mətiwuaj
S.TRANSL: 由於噶瑪蘭人有很多的迷信, 比方說巫師之類的東西.
Since Kavalan people have many superstitions, such as something about witches.

S.FORM: zinna kasianem.
S.PHON: [z|r]inna kasianəm
S.FORM: zinna kasianem.
S.PHON: [z|r]inna kasianəm
S.TRANSL: 他們如此認為.
They think so.

S.FORM: yau 'nay lasap lasapay Ray naRay Raybang taqati tu taiyan tu qayzuanan.
S.PHON: jau ʔnaj rasap rasapaj ʁaj naʁaj ʁajβaŋ taqati tu taijan tu qaj[z|r]uanan
S.FORM: yau 'nay lasap lasapay Ray naRay Raybang taqati tu taiyan tu qayzuanan.
S.PHON: jau ʔnaj rasap rasapaj ʁaj naʁaj ʁajβaŋ taqati tu taijan tu qaj[z|r]uanan
S.TRANSL: 某個地方有髒東西的時候, 他們就會放棄那裡.
When there is something dirty (unclean) in a place, they will abandon that place.

S.FORM: nayau supaRti 'daq.
S.PHON: najau supaʁti ʔɮaq
S.FORM: nayau supaRti 'daq.
S.PHON: najau supaʁti ʔɮaq
S.TRANSL: 別人知道了這件事.
Others knew it.

S.FORM: supaRti busus tu waway na kebalan Ranaw nayawannati.
S.PHON: supaʁti βusus tu wawaj na kəβaran ʁanaw najawannati
S.FORM: supaRti busus tu waway na kebalan Ranaw nayawannati.
S.PHON: supaʁti βusus tu wawaj na kəβaran ʁanaw najawannati
S.TRANSL: 漢人知道了噶瑪蘭的習俗, 所以他們就那樣.
The Han people knew the customs of Kavalan, so they did so.

S.FORM: XXXX spaw tu patayay wasu u pa'tayay taquq spawanna ta zengnana qaniaw.
S.PHON: **** spaw tu patajaj wasu u paʔtajaj taquq spawanna ta [z|r]əŋnana qaniaw
S.FORM: XXXX spaw tu patayay wasu u pa'tayay taquq spawanna ta zengnana qaniaw.
S.PHON: **** spaw tu patajaj wasu u paʔtajaj taquq spawanna ta [z|r]əŋnana qaniaw
S.TRANSL: 他們把死狗或死雞丟到水田裡.
They left dead dogs or chickens in the farm.

S.FORM: titaanna baq na baqita na bayita nani.
S.PHON: titaanna βaq na βaqita na βajita nani
S.FORM: titaanna baq na baqita na bayita nani.
S.PHON: titaanna βaq na βaqita na βajita nani
S.TRANSL: 我們的祖先們就看到了(田裡死去的狗或雞).
Our ancestors saw them (dead dogs or chickens in the farm).

S.FORM: mana yau nazawai patayay sukaw nayaway zinna baqi.
S.PHON: mana jau na[z|r]awai patajaj sukaw najawaj [z|r]inna βaqi
S.FORM: mana yau nazawai patayay sukaw nayaway zinna baqi.
S.PHON: mana jau na[z|r]awai patajaj sukaw najawaj [z|r]inna βaqi
S.TRANSL: 怎麼會有這樣的死掉的東西,那樣的東西不好,我們的祖先這樣想.
'How come there are such dead things.' 'That kind of things are bad,' thought our ancestors.

FORM.notes: source note: baqian=ti aizipna, old=PFV 3SG.NOM, 老=完成 3SG.主格, ‘He is old.’

S.FORM: izauannati tayan idadannati sukawti kowayan zau zinna baqian haw.
S.PHON: i[z|r]auannati tajan iɮaɮannati sukawti k*wajan [z|r]au [z|r]inna βaqian haw
S.FORM: izauannati tayan idadannati sukawti kowayan zau zinna baqian haw.
S.PHON: i[z|r]auannati tajan iɮaɮannati sukawti k*wajan [z|r]au [z|r]inna βaqian haw
S.TRANSL: 他們把地留在那裡不管,並且把它圍起來,這個田就不能耕作了,老人們這麼想.
(They) left them there and surrounded (that place). The land cannot be plowed, thought the elders.

S.FORM: nani tenes maiti niquayanay titaanna na busus nani.
S.PHON: nani tənəs maiti niquajanaj titaanna na βusus nani
S.FORM: nani tenes maiti niquayanay titaanna na busus nani.
S.PHON: nani tənəs maiti niquajanaj titaanna na βusus nani
S.TRANSL: 那個很久沒有人耕作的田被漢人看到了.
The land which had not been plowed for a long time was seen by the Hans.

W.TRANSL: 完成-耕作-名物化=關係詞

S.FORM: mai kowayannumi zau.
S.PHON: mai k*wajannumi [z|r]au
S.FORM: mai kowayannumi zau.
S.PHON: mai k*wajannumi [z|r]au
S.TRANSL: 你們很久沒有耕作這塊田了.
(You) haven't plowed this land for a long time.

S.FORM: aikupati zinna sadiwayannati nayau zengna na baqian taiyan nani.
S.PHON: aikupati [z|r]inna saɮiwajannati najau [z|r]əŋna na βaqian taijan nani
S.FORM: aikupati zinna sadiwayannati nayau zengna na baqian taiyan nani.
S.PHON: aikupati [z|r]inna saɮiwajannati najau [z|r]əŋna na βaqian taijan nani
S.TRANSL: "輪到我佔據(噶瑪蘭)祖先那邊的田地了", 漢人這麼想.
It's my turn, thought the Hans, to occupy the farms of the (Kavalan) ancestors there.

S.FORM: Runtu tabay pamengti masiyun masiyun nani pamengti kitutti.
S.PHON: ʁuntu taβaj paməŋti masijun masijun nani paməŋti kitutti
S.FORM: Runtu tabay pamengti masiyun masiyun nani pamengti kitutti.
S.PHON: ʁuntu taβaj paməŋti masijun masijun nani paməŋti kitutti
S.TRANSL: 土地本來很寬大,但不知不覺地漸漸變小了.
The land was originally wide and large, but became smaller gradually.

S.FORM: titaanna baqian taiyanan 'nay baq na baqita taiyan nani.
S.PHON: titaanna βaqian taijanan ʔnaj βaq na βaqita taijan nani
S.FORM: titaanna baqian taiyanan 'nay baq na baqita taiyan nani.
S.PHON: titaanna βaqian taijanan ʔnaj βaq na βaqita taijan nani
S.TRANSL: 我們的祖先看了之後.
Our ancestors there saw it.

S.FORM: maitiita tu zengna taziyan.
S.PHON: maitiita tu [z|r]əŋna ta[z|r]ijan
S.FORM: maitiita tu zengna taziyan.
S.PHON: maitiita tu [z|r]əŋna ta[z|r]ijan
S.TRANSL: 我們這邊沒有田了.
We had no farms here.

S.FORM: samawmangpaita taziyan ka.
S.PHON: samawmaŋpaita ta[z|r]ijan ka
S.FORM: samawmangpaita taziyan ka.
S.PHON: samawmaŋpaita ta[z|r]ijan ka
S.TRANSL: 我們在這邊也沒用, 幹嘛留在這裡呢.
It's useless for us to stay here.

FORM.notes: source note: imis: north | source note: wakay: east | source note: zaya: west | source note: qawanan: right | source note: qawili: left | source note: babaw: top | source note: libeng: bottom | source note: pasa tiboR=pa=iku, toward south=FUT=1SG.NOM, 往 南=未來=1SG.主格, ‘我要往南走’

S.FORM: qangima sayza matadin zinna nani matadinti pasa tiboR.
S.PHON: qaŋima saj[z|r]a mataɮin [z|r]inna nani mataɮinti pasa tiβ*ʁ
S.FORM: qangima sayza matadin zinna nani matadinti pasa tiboR.
S.PHON: qaŋima saj[z|r]a mataɮin [z|r]inna nani mataɮinti pasa tiβ*ʁ
S.TRANSL: 他們想說乾脆離開好了,(所以)他們就往南遷移.
They think they should leave (so) they left for the south.

FORM.notes: source note: buRaw是指群體遷移

S.FORM: mzaqis tu ipaz qabawaay sumaqaiay nayawti mbuRaw pasa qalinku.
S.PHON: m[z|r]aqis tu ipa[z|r] qaβawaaj sumaqaiaj najawti mβuʁaw pasa qarinku
S.FORM: mzaqis tu ipaz qabawaay sumaqaiay nayawti mbuRaw pasa qalinku.
S.PHON: m[z|r]aqis tu ipa[z|r] qaβawaaj sumaqaiaj najawti mβuʁaw pasa qarinku
S.TRANSL: (他們)搭竹筏,搭船,或走路遷移往花蓮.
(They) left for Hualien by raft, boat, or on foot.

S.FORM: muna niqaqaanna maseq tu qalinku nani.
S.PHON: muna niqaqaanna masəq tu qarinku nani
S.FORM: muna niqaqaanna maseq tu qalinku nani.
S.PHON: muna niqaqaanna masəq tu qarinku nani
S.TRANSL: 他們首先到達的地方是花蓮.
The place where they arrived first is Hualien.

S.FORM: yau taizaan taqeliawanan maseq taqeliawanan.
S.PHON: jau tai[z|r]aan taqəriawanan masəq taqəriawanan
S.FORM: yau taizaan taqeliawanan maseq taqeliawanan.
S.PHON: jau tai[z|r]aan taqəriawanan masəq taqəriawanan
S.TRANSL: 有到那個茄禮村, 到達茄禮村.
In qeliawanan.

FORM.notes: source note: qaizuwan-an-ku, live-NMZ-1SG.GEN, 住-名物化-1SG.屬格, ‘my place’

S.FORM: wa tabay taziyan nengi qaizuwanan ta taziyan zinna qaniawu nani.
S.PHON: wa taβaj ta[z|r]ijan nəŋi qai[z|r]uwanan ta ta[z|r]ijan [z|r]inna qaniawu nani
S.FORM: wa tabay taziyan nengi qaizuwanan ta taziyan zinna qaniawu nani.
S.PHON: wa taβaj ta[z|r]ijan nəŋi qai[z|r]uwanan ta ta[z|r]ijan [z|r]inna qaniawu nani
S.TRANSL: 他們說, '這裡很寬,是可以住的好地方.
'It is so wide here and is thus a good place for living,' said they.

S.FORM: taziyanti qaniau kumoway.
S.PHON: ta[z|r]ijanti qaniau kum*waj
S.FORM: taziyanti qaniau kumoway.
S.PHON: ta[z|r]ijanti qaniau kum*waj
S.TRANSL: 他們在這裡開墾了.
They plowed here.

FORM.notes: source note: ma-quan-ay, MA-govern-REL, MA-管-關係詞, ‘被管的人’

S.FORM: neng tengnes nani yauti zipun tu mizaay tu lazat tayan kuanay tu iza nani.
S.PHON: nəŋ təŋnəs nani jauti [z|r]ipun tu mi[z|r]aaj tu ra[z|r]at tajan kuanaj tu i[z|r]a nani
S.FORM: neng tengnes nani yauti zipun tu mizaay tu lazat tayan kuanay tu iza nani.
S.PHON: nəŋ təŋnəs nani jauti [z|r]ipun tu mi[z|r]aaj tu ra[z|r]at tajan kuanaj tu i[z|r]a nani
S.TRANSL: 過了很久,有日本人來管理這些人.
After a long time, there (came) Japanese governing these people.

FORM.notes: source note: qawtu sayza, come maybe, 來 可能, ‘可能會來’ | source note: mawtu sayza, AF.come maybe, 主焦.來 可能, ‘可能來過’

S.FORM: titaanna skaw sayza ni nikuananna nani.
S.PHON: titaanna skaw saj[z|r]a ni nikuananna nani
S.FORM: titaanna skaw sayza ni nikuananna nani.
S.PHON: titaanna skaw saj[z|r]a ni nikuananna nani
S.TRANSL: 看了之後,(我們祖先)可能認為管理的方式不好.
After seeing this, (our ancestors) probably thought that how the Japanese governed the people was bad."

S.FORM: mizati masawati tu zipun.
S.PHON: mi[z|r]ati masawati tu [z|r]ipun
S.FORM: mizati masawati tu zipun.
S.PHON: mi[z|r]ati masawati tu [z|r]ipun
S.TRANSL: 就跟日本人打.
They fought against the Japanese.

S.FORM: suqas kebalan atu qizaya' taiyan nani.
S.PHON: suqas kəβaran atu qi[z|r]ajaʔ taijan nani
S.FORM: suqas kebalan atu qizaya' taiyan nani.
S.PHON: suqas kəβaran atu qi[z|r]ajaʔ taijan nani
S.TRANSL: 噶瑪蘭和阿美族輸了.
Kavalan and Amis there lost.

FORM.notes: source note: matalin: 換(位置/地方/公司) | source note: quqang: 換(東西)

S.FORM: maitis qakapaRanna zipun nani matalinti uman.
S.PHON: maitis qakapaʁanna [z|r]ipun nani matarinti uman
S.FORM: maitis qakapaRanna zipun nani matalinti uman.
S.PHON: maitis qakapaʁanna [z|r]ipun nani matarinti uman
S.TRANSL: 怕被日本人抓到, (他們)再換地方.
(They) are afraid of being caught by the Japanese so transferred to another place again.

S.FORM: sa pasazui ta qoRo'an tataqemuanan.
S.PHON: sa pasa[z|r]ui ta q*ʁ*ʔan tataqəmuanan
S.FORM: sa pasazui ta qoRo'an tataqemuanan.
S.PHON: sa pasa[z|r]ui ta q*ʁ*ʔan tataqəmuanan
S.TRANSL: 往那個磯萁和龜庵.
To qoRo' and taqemuan.

S.FORM: yau tataqemuanan yau tasinsiaan yau ta a yau pateR tapateRungan.
S.PHON: jau tataqəmuanan jau tasinsiaan jau ta a jau patəʁ tapatəʁuŋan
S.FORM: yau tataqemuanan yau tasinsiaan yau ta a yau pateR tapateRungan.
S.PHON: jau tataqəmuanan jau tasinsiaan jau ta a jau patəʁ tapatəʁuŋan
S.TRANSL: 有到龜庵,有到新社.
To taqemuan and pateRung

S.FORM: yau sa kulis pasazuiti uman taqeladutan atu ta tachenggongan zinna haw.
S.PHON: jau sa kuris pasa[z|r]uiti uman taqəraɮutan atu ta taʦhəŋg*ŋan [z|r]inna haw
S.FORM: yau sa kulis pasazuiti uman taqeladutan atu ta tachenggongan zinna haw.
S.PHON: jau sa kuris pasa[z|r]uiti uman taqəraɮutan atu ta taʦhəŋg*ŋan [z|r]inna haw
S.TRANSL: 有到立德,往那個方向再到樟原和成功.
To kulis, qeladut and chenggong.

S.FORM: X aimi baqiniq yau tasinsiaan tumuqaz tayan.
S.PHON: * aimi βaqiniq jau tasinsiaan tumuqa[z|r] tajan
S.FORM: X aimi baqiniq yau tasinsiaan tumuqaz tayan.
S.PHON: * aimi βaqiniq jau tasinsiaan tumuqa[z|r] tajan
S.TRANSL: 我們的祖先在新社那邊停下來上岸.
Our ancestors went ashore there in Sinshe.

S.FORM: smuRong titaanna naung 'nay tayan.
S.PHON: smuʁ*ŋ titaanna nauŋ ʔnaj tajan
S.FORM: smuRong titaanna naung 'nay tayan.
S.PHON: smuʁ*ŋ titaanna nauŋ ʔnaj tajan
S.TRANSL: 上岸後, 看到那裡的山.
After landing, they saw the mountains there.

FORM.notes: source note: pazaki aiku timaizipana | source note: approach 1SG.NOM 3SG.OBL | source note: 接近 1SG.主格 3SG.斜格 | source note: ‘我靠近他’

S.FORM: yau iRuR hoN yau naung mzaki tu lazing zinna Ranaw.
S.PHON: jau iʁuʁ h*n jau nauŋ m[z|r]aki tu ra[z|r]iŋ [z|r]inna ʁanaw
S.FORM: yau iRuR hoN yau naung mzaki tu lazing zinna Ranaw.
S.PHON: jau iʁuʁ h*n jau nauŋ m[z|r]aki tu ra[z|r]iŋ [z|r]inna ʁanaw
S.TRANSL: 有河,有山,又靠近海邊,他們說.
There are rivers and mountains and (the place) is near the sea, said they

S.FORM: aimi kebalan mlizaq tu sazanumay.
S.PHON: aimi kəβaran mri[z|r]aq tu sa[z|r]anumaj
S.FORM: aimi kebalan mlizaq tu sazanumay.
S.PHON: aimi kəβaran mri[z|r]aq tu sa[z|r]anumaj
S.TRANSL: 我們噶瑪蘭人喜歡有水的(地方).
We Kavalan people like the place with water.

S.FORM: yau zanum yau zanum smuRuz e zinna.
S.PHON: jau [z|r]anum jau [z|r]anum smuʁu[z|r] ə [z|r]inna
S.FORM: yau zanum yau zanum smuRuz e zinna.
S.PHON: jau [z|r]anum jau [z|r]anum smuʁu[z|r] ə [z|r]inna
S.TRANSL: 他們說,有水我們可以生存.
With water, we can survive, said they.

S.FORM: Ranaw yauti tasinsiaan.
S.PHON: ʁanaw jauti tasinsiaan
S.FORM: Ranaw yauti tasinsiaan.
S.PHON: ʁanaw jauti tasinsiaan
S.TRANSL: 所以就在新社.
Thus, (they stayed) in Xinshe.

S.FORM: mzaki tu lazing mzaki tu naung mzaki tu iRuR nayaw nani.
S.PHON: m[z|r]aki tu ra[z|r]iŋ m[z|r]aki tu nauŋ m[z|r]aki tu iʁuʁ najaw nani
S.FORM: mzaki tu lazing mzaki tu naung mzaki tu iRuR nayaw nani.
S.PHON: m[z|r]aki tu ra[z|r]iŋ m[z|r]aki tu nauŋ m[z|r]aki tu iʁuʁ najaw nani
S.TRANSL: 靠近海邊,靠近山,靠近河,那樣" .
Near the sea, near the mountain, (and) near a river.

S.FORM: tayanti niz sinsiaay 'nay tangi.
S.PHON: tajanti ni[z|r] sinsiaaj ʔnaj taŋi
S.FORM: tayanti niz sinsiaay 'nay tangi.
S.PHON: tajanti ni[z|r] sinsiaaj ʔnaj taŋi
S.TRANSL: 現在新社的所有的人在那邊.
All the Xinshe people now were there.

FORM.notes: source note: nizi taziyan tuzus sinsia | source note: from here to PN | source note: 從 這裡 到 新社 | source note: ‘從這裡到新社’

S.FORM: tuzus tu tangi aw tengnesti qaya tasaw.
S.PHON: tu[z|r]us tu taŋi aw təŋnəsti qaja tasaw
S.FORM: tuzus tu tangi aw tengnesti qaya tasaw.
S.PHON: tu[z|r]us tu taŋi aw təŋnəsti qaja tasaw
S.TRANSL: 一直到現在,時間也很久了.
Till now it has been a long time.

S.FORM: Rasiw u utaniti smani Rasiwbuanna Ringuanta nani.
S.PHON: ʁasiw u utaniti smani ʁasiwβuanna ʁiŋuanta nani
